verdict.rationale: Gitleaks scans git repos, directories/files, and stdin regardless of language, using regex-based rule matching rather than language-specific parsers, and supports custom/composite rules for org-specific ecosystems. However, evidence never demonstrates explicit coverage or validated accuracy across major package ecosystems (npm, PyPI, Maven, Go modules, etc.) or language-specific secret formats beyond generic pattern matching. missing for 10: evidence of ecosystem/language-specific rule packs or validation, accuracy benchmarks across languages, and explicit multi-language/package-manager coverage claims.
